description: GroupName wraps a String but does not implement AsRef<str> or From<GroupName> for String. Code that needs to pass a GroupName to a function expecting &str must call .as_str() explicitly. Implementing AsRef<str> enables GroupName to be used wherever &str is expected (e.g., as a HashMap key with Borrow, in format!, in sqlx .bind()). Implementing From<GroupName> for String follows std convention for lossless conversions.
title: core: GroupName lacks AsRef<str> and From<GroupName> for String impls
